summary_en: Buyback authorization: 100,000 shares (0.92% of S/O), ¥500M upper limit, open-market purchase via TSE (managed discretionary), Aug 12, 2026–Jan 31, 2027. Concurrent cancellation: 67,700 shares (0.62% of S/O), effective Aug 31, 2026. Rationale: sustain total payout ratio target of ≥40% and retire treasury shares acquired under prior Feb 2026 program completed June 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury stock and cancellation of treasury stock
translation_en_brief: On Aug 10, 2026, Sinanen Holdings' board resolved to acquire treasury stock and cancel existing treasury stock under the Companies Act and its articles of incorporation. The buyback is authorized at 100,000 shares (0.92% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) with a ¥500M upper limit, executed via open-market purchase on the TSE using a managed discretionary mandate from Aug 12, 2026 through Jan 31, 2027. The acquisition supports the company's total payout ratio target of ≥40% established in the May 2026 capital-allocation policy update. Concurrently, the company will cancel 67,700 shares (0.62% of shares outstanding) on Aug 31, 2026—the entirety of treasury stock acquired under a prior Feb 10, 2026 authorization and completed on June 11, 2026. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 206,647 treasury shares against 10,839,944 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
